{{Conjecture|legends}}
'''2nd Regiment''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] formation based in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tiems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. 2nd Regiment fought in the [[Battle of Tiems]], attacking [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] troops along the [[Tiems Road]]. When Alliance forces fell back, 2nd Regiment followed and was caught in a trap by other Alliance forces that almost completely destroyed the unit.
